behavior: When `KeepAlive` deactivates a popup, the popup keeps its open state. It releases the scroll lock, the modal marks, the document listeners and the timers. The portal element of the popup leaves the document. When `KeepAlive` activates the popup again, the popup takes them back, and the same portal element returns. A popup that mounts while `KeepAlive` holds its branch stays out of the document. It takes no scroll lock, no modal marks, no focus and no document listener, and it reports no open state, until the activation.
